== Trivia ==
* This [[Armor]] set can be paired with a {{Item|Magma Cube Pet|rarity=l}} to buff the Armor's [[Stats]] by up to 50% at Level 100. (The Armor [[Item Upgrades|Upgrades]] will be buffed too).
* This armor is a direct reference to the [[Ember Armor]], a legacy armor set crafted with materials from the old [[Magma Cube Boss]] in the [[Blazing Fortress]].

== Tips ==
* Currently, the tiered bonus is bugged to not do anything. The following advice is written for if the bonus is fixed to work properly.
* This armor is a viable option for early to mid game, due to it only costing {{BZC|24 Rekindled Ember Fragment}} for decent stats as well as [[Gemstone Slots]]. The main part of the armor, however, is the extra {{Ench|Fire Aspect}} damage. Using {{Ench|Fire Aspect 3}}, the {{Green|600%}} outgoing burning damage results in an effective {{Green|{{#EXPR: 1.63 / 1.09 round 3}}x}} multiplier to first hit damage ({{Green|{{#EXPR: 1.81 / 1.09 round 3}}}}x at {{Green|800%}}), allowing the user to kill {{Item|Ghost}}s or {{Item|Sven Packmaster}}s in 1 hit.
** Furthermore, due to being a tiered armor set, it can be paired nicely with the {{Item|Tarantula Helmet}} or {{Item|Primordial Helmet}}.
** Due to the armor stats not mattering as much as the passive, it is recommended to avoid using the {{Item|Magma Cube Pet}}, focusing instead on pets increasing damage such as the {{Item|Lion Pet}} or {{Item|Wither Skeleton Pet}}.
** While this armor is better than base {{Item|Crimson Armor}} at first, it gets outclassed at Fiery Crimson or higher.
